title: 서비스 in Korea = FREE 🥟 (just don't ask for more 😅) #learnkorean
caption:
서비스 (seo-bi-seu) = FREE — it's on the house 🥟
In a Korean restaurant, when the owner brings food you didn't order and says 서비스~!, you don't pay for it.
Mongle didn't know… so the more food came, the more money it pushed over 😅

Words in this video:
서비스 (seo-bi-seu) = something extra for free, from the shop
얼마예요? (eol-ma-ye-yo?) = How much is it?
또 (tto) = more, again
이것도 (i-geot-do) = this too
공짜 (gong-jja) = free
더 주세요 (deo ju-se-yo) = Please give me more
계산서 (gye-san-seo) = the bill
아니에요? (a-ni-e-yo?) = It isn't…?

Tip: 서비스 is the owner's gift — it's not something you ask for. Ask for more and you get the bill 😂 Just say 감사합니다! (gam-sa-ham-ni-da = Thank you!)

pinnedComment: What did YOU get as 서비스 in Korea? 🥟👇
alt: A needle-felt miniature Korean-Chinese restaurant lit by red felt lanterns. A felt restaurant owner in a white cap and red apron sets a plate of fried dumplings in front of Mongle, a coral felt blob mascot with no arms, and says 서비스~! (It's free~!). Sweating, Mongle pushes its yellow felt wallet to the owner's hand: 얼마예요…? (How much is it…?). Delighted, the owner brings more: sweet-and-sour pork (또 서비스~! More free food~!), then a big bowl of jjamppong until the table is full (이것도 서비스~! This one's free too~!). Mongle spills its coins and, eyes squeezed shut, shoves the whole pile over: 다… 얼마예요? (How much for all this?). The owner laughs, waves 'no, no' and pushes the coins and wallet back: 서비스는 공짜야~! (서비스 = FREE!). Mongle gets star eyes, flattens with relief and repeats 서비스… 공짜! Later, with a stack of empty dishes, Mongle balances an empty plate on its head and asks 서비스 더 주세요~! (More freebies, please~!). The owner's smile freezes and he hands over a slip: 계산서~ (Your bill~). Close-up of the felt bill: the dumplings, the sweet-and-sour pork and the jjamppong each say ₩0, and only one line costs ₩8,000, circled — a little felt speech bubble that says 더 주세요~! (More, please~!). Mongle jumps in shock, mouth wide open, the plate tipping on its head, and gasps 서비스… 아니에요?! (It's not free?!).
_비고: video.mp4 = e64 v8 최종본(음량마감). v7 계산서의 넷째 줄(빈 접시)을 「더 주세요~!」 말풍선으로 바꾸고, 끝 칸에 몽글 되물음 「서비스… 아니에요?!」을 넣고, 바탕 분식집 잡음을 뺐다(유호님 11-27 「화이트노이즈 소리랑 … 마지막에 이해가 잘 안가」 → 「응, 고쳐」). 표지 cover.png = 상이 가득 찬 칸 5 위에 머리 글. 어린이 전용 아님. 합성 표시: 켜지 않음 — 펠트 미니어처 그림 · 영상은 GPT 이미지와 Flow로 만든 꾸민 장면이고 실제 사람 · 사건을 흉내 내지 않으며, 목소리는 특정인이 아닌 TTS. 11-30 21:00 예약은 v5(KexrQf7U9zo)를 비공개로 내리고 이 판으로 바꿔 건다.
